name: first-volley
unmodelled: v1 note: fight_calc.py reports CONSTANT_DRIFT on 31 of 60 constants (pre-#44 ward pass, body guard, health_units 16, art lint 12 per cost). n_body is the real 0.956 x 4 to restore health_units 64; the ward is the Nascent Soul Common Ward (557 points, stops 84.8 %) written as pass 0.152 at drain 0.124 per point blocked, which the old model floors at drain_min 0.15. Art coefficients follow the #44 lint (24 per cost share), so the old lint flags them. Results are observations under the old rules, not the fight check.
opening_haste: +250 % opening haste puts every first firing at the 0.5 s floor; fight_calc starts each art at its full cd_eff (1.333 s), so the volley it shows comes at 1.333 s
unanswered: modelled as L5 +72 (Unanswered 40 + Eruption 15 + Taut String 17) while the enemy is at full health, an approximation of 'the enemy has fired no art' and of the first volley
eruption and taut_string: folded into the conditional above; their true reads (arts fired this instant, opening haste clipped on a first firing) are not expressible
first_move: the Breaker's first firing costs nothing
unyielding_breath: one refusal (the tie-breaker against a 0.5 s opener)
final_clause: the Breaker fires free as a last act at Down
flowing_water: each crit pulls the other arts' timers 0.5 s closer (3 a pulse)
iron_spark conversion 60 % Lightning to Physical (fight_calc kinds are body/qi only)
lightning_step escape art (slot 6) and Cold Feet
the post-#44 defence path: resistance points with the drain bill on prevented points, pay_frac leak, flat block
v1 ward shape {"pass": 0.152, "drain": 0.124} (pass and drain shares are retired; modelled as the Common Ward at this ws and we, every ward layer at cap)
_comment: Migrated from fight_calc.py format v1 by tools/design/combat_sim/migrate_fight_v1.py (2026-11-11). Art kinds: qi -> elem, body -> phys, no element stacks. Costs kept (post-#44 file). Ward: v1 ws and we kept, every ward layer at cap (top-end build). Everything with no new field is in unmodelled, prefixed v1.
